event.title: Upper Assam floods · July 2026
event.subtitle: Golaghat · Jorhat · Sivasagar · Charaideo · Majuli
event.context: Cloudburst over Mon district, Nagaland on 19 Jul 2026 swelled the Dikhow, Disang, Janji and Dhansiri while a high Brahmaputra blocked their drainage (Wikipedia: 2026 Assam floods; Assam University report).
event.caveat: July is Sali rice transplanting season, so some newly flooded paddies count as new water; the 15 Aug map (290 km², paddies still flooded) caps that share. The Assam University report counts ~2.12 lakh people displaced: displacement is a subset of living inside the flood extent.

validation.protocol: Leave-one-date-out: trained on two NISAR/Sentinel-2 pairs, scored on the third (other date or track). Reference: Sentinel-2 cloud-free open water. 95% CIs by spatial block bootstrap.
